description: This PHP source file defines the 'testplan' class as part of the TestLink testing management framework. It manages test plan entities, including creation, update, linking test cases, copying, deletion, and related operations such as milestones, test case versions, user roles, and associated artifacts. The class interacts with the database via the $db handler and references multiple related classes for managing nodes, test cases, platforms, and other components.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class to coordinate and manage test plans within TestLink, providing methods for CRUD operations, copying, linking test cases, managing milestones, user roles, and deletion of test plans along with related artifacts.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: This class manages test plans in TestLink, providing methods for creating, reading, updating, deleting, copying, linking test cases, managing milestones and user roles, handling platform links, custom fields, and exporting data to XML.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test plan in the database linked to a specified test project, setting its notes, activity status, and visibility.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a test plan from a given object, performing integrity checks and inserting into database.

methods.name: updateFromObject
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan's details with data from a provided object.

methods.name: checkNameExistence
methods.description: Checks if a test plan name is already in use within a specific test project, excluding a given ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name, notes, and activity/public status of a test plan identified by ID.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves test plan information based on its name and optional project filter.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about a test plan by its ID, with various output options.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Retrieves all test plans in the database.

methods.name: count_testcases
methods.description: Counts test cases linked to a test plan, optionally filtered by platform or groupings.

methods.name: tcversionInfoForAudit
methods.description: Fetches test case version info required for audit messages, including version and external ID details.

methods.name: link_tcversions
methods.description: Associates specific versions of test cases to a test plan and logs audit events.

methods.name: setExecutionOrder
methods.description: Sets execution order for test case versions within a test plan.

methods.name: get_linked_items_id
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of items linked to the test plan.

methods.name: get_linked_tcvid
methods.description: Fetches linked test case versions for a plan filtered by platform and other options.

methods.name: getLinkedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of linked test case versions in a plan.

methods.name: getFeatureID
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with a test plan for a given platform and test case version.

methods.name: getRootTestSuites
methods.description: Retrieves root test suites associated with the test plan.

methods.name: helper_keywords_sql
methods.description: Builds SQL join/filter clauses for keyword filtering based on provided keywords.

methods.name: helper_urgency_sql
methods.description: Builds SQL filter snippet based on urgency and importance thresholds.

methods.name: helper_assigned_to_sql
methods.description: Builds SQL join/filter for filtering by assigned users.

methods.name: helper_exec_status_filter
methods.description: Constructs SQL filter snippet based on execution status codes.

methods.name: helper_bugs_sql
methods.description: Builds SQL join/filter clauses for bug IDs filtering.

methods.name: get_linked_and_newest_tcversions
methods.description: Returns mapping of current linked test case versions and latest available versions for each test case in the plan.

methods.name: unlink_tcversions
methods.description: Removes links between test cases and the test plan, cleaning related artifacts and audit logging.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Retrieves a map of keywords associated with test case versions in a plan.

methods.name: DEPRECATED_get_keywords_tcases
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve test cases associated with certain keywords.

methods.name: getKeywordsLinkedTCVersions
methods.description: Gets map of keywords linked to test case versions in a plan.

methods.name: getPlatformsLinkedTCVersions
methods.description: Retrieves platform associations for test case versions within a plan.

methods.name: copy_as
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing test plan, possibly with different test project, name, and associated elements.

methods.name: copy_builds
methods.description: Copies builds from source to new test plan, returning mapping of old to new IDs.

methods.name: copy_linked_tcversions
methods.description: Copies linked test case versions from source test plan to new plan, handling versions, platform, and user assignment mappings.

methods.name: copy_milestones
methods.description: Copies milestones from an existing test plan to a new one.

methods.name: get_milestones
methods.description: Retrieves milestones associated with a test plan.

methods.name: copy_user_roles
methods.description: Copies user roles from one test plan to another.

methods.name: getUserRoleIDs
methods.description: Retrieves user roles associated with a test plan.

methods.name: addUserRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user for a specific test plan, logging the audit event.

methods.name: deleteUserRoles
methods.description: Removes user roles assignments for a test plan.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test plan and all its associated artifacts, including test cases, builds, milestones, roles, and related database entries.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test plan and all related artifacts such as test case links, builds, milestones, roles, and attachments, executing SQL delete statements and removing associated data.

methods.name: get_builds_for_html_options
methods.description: Retrieves build options for HTML select inputs, filtered by active and open status, ordered by name, with options for including/excluding specific builds.

methods.name: get_max_build_id
methods.description: Returns the maximum build ID for a given test plan, optionally filtered by active and open status.

methods.name: get_testsuites
methods.description: Retrieves a flat list of test suites and their ancestors associated with a test plan, including nested suites, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: compare_name
methods.description: Static helper method to compare two test suite names for sorting purposes.

methods.name: get_parenttestsuites
methods.description: Recursive function to retrieve all ancestor test suites of a given test suite ID.

methods.name: get_builds
methods.description: Returns a map of builds linked to the test plan, filtered by active and open status, with options for ordering, counting, and specific build IDs.

methods.name: get_build_by_name
methods.description: Fetches a build by name within a test plan, returning its details.

methods.name: get_build_by_id
methods.description: Fetches a build by ID within a test plan, returning its details.

methods.name: getNumberOfBuilds
methods.description: Returns the total number of builds associated with a test plan, with optional filters for active and open status.

methods.name: _natsort_builds
methods.description: Sorts a map of builds by their name in natural order.

methods.name: check_build_name_existence
methods.description: Checks if a build name exists within a test plan, with optional build ID exclusion for updates.

methods.name: get_build_id_by_name

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_id
methods.description: Returns a map of custom field IDs to labels for a specific test project, considering enabled and show_on_execution flags.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML table inputs for custom fields linked to a test plan in design or execution scope.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generates HTML table displaying the current values of linked custom fields for a test plan, with optional filters.

methods.name: filterByOnDesignCustomFields
methods.description: Filters a set of test case IDs based on the values of specified custom fields, at design time.

methods.name: get_estimated_execution_time
methods.description: Calculates total estimated execution time from a custom field or from linked test case versions for a test plan.

methods.name: getEstimatedExecutionTime
methods.description: Aggregates estimated execution durations from linked test case versions and platforms for a test plan.

methods.name: getEstimatedExecutionTimeFromCF
methods.description: Aggregates estimated execution durations based on values stored in a custom field across linked test case versions.

methods.name: get_execution_time
methods.description: Calculates total execution time from custom fields or execution data for a test plan.

methods.name: getExecutionTime
methods.description: Deprecated version of get_execution_time, performs similar calculation for test execution time.

methods.name: getExecutionTimeFromCF
methods.description: Calculates total execution time from custom field values in test case executions.

methods.name: get_prev_builds
methods.description: Retrieves previous builds before a specified build ID for a test plan, optionally filtered by active status.

methods.name: get_same_status_for_build_set
methods.description: Returns test case versions that share the same execution status across a set of builds and platform.

methods.name: get_not_run_for_any_build

methods.name: copy_platforms_links
methods.description: Copies platform links from one test plan to another, optionally remapping platform IDs.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copies attachments from one test plan to another.

methods.name: getPlatforms

methods.name: hasLinkedPlatforms
methods.description: Checks whether a test plan has active linked platforms.

methods.name: changeLinkedTCVersionsPlatform

methods.name: countLinkedTCVersionsByPlatform
methods.description: Counts linked test case versions grouped by platform within a test plan.

methods.name: getStatusForReports
methods.description: Provides status codes mapped to labels for reporting purposes.

methods.name: getTestCaseSiblings
methods.description: Retrieves sibling test case versions for a given test case in a test plan, optionally filtered by user assignment.

methods.name: getTestCaseNextSibling

methods.name: urgencyImportanceToPriorityLevel

methods.description: Exports linked platforms and test cases of a test plan to an XML structure.

methods.name: exportTestPlanDataToXML
methods.description: Exports comprehensive test plan data, including hierarchy, test cases, platforms, builds, test project info, into an XML format.

methods.name: exportTestSuiteDataToXML
methods.description: Recursively exports test suite and test case data into XML, including associated keywords and custom fields, filtered by test plan and project.

methods.name: getFeatureAssignments

methods.name: getSkeleton

methods.name: getNotRunAtLeastOneBuildForPlatform

methods.name: getNotRunFullOnPlatform

methods.name: getNotRunPartialOnPlatform
